description: This Kotlin source file defines the CalculatorEngine object, which parses and evaluates mathematical expressions supporting various operators, functions, and parentheses. It includes a recursive descent parser and handles a range of mathematical operations and functions such as sin, cos, tan, log, ln, sqrt, and supports arithmetic operators +, -, *, /, ^.
